title: Build a validated directed adjacency list
prompt: Given n<=100 and directed (from,to) pairs, return n neighbor vectors in insertion order. Keep duplicate edges. Reject n>100 or any endpoint outside [0,n) with invalid_argument. n=0 is valid only without edges.

tests.label: Reject endpoint
tests.hint: Index n is outside the range.

tests.label: Isolated vertex
tests.hint: Keep vertices even with no outgoing edges.

hints: The pair names source first, destination second.
explanation: One list owns the outgoing neighbors of one vertex. The starter reverses every arrow: the sample begins with 0: instead of 0:1 2. A matrix makes edge tests direct but uses n*n cells; lists suit sparse networks. The new graph is built locally, so a rejected edge never mutates a caller’s existing graph. Keep directedness explicit in source and diagrams.
